🚀 Crypto Market Hits $3 Trillion! 🚀 

With Trump’s election victory, optimism over pro-crypto regulations has driven the crypto market to a record $3.2 trillion cap. Bitcoin $BTC hit an all-time high of $93,480, while major assets like Ether and Dogecoin saw significant gains. https://t.co/RUbOCFXEdL

The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has acknowledged Grayscale's filings for ETFs based on Dogecoin $DOGE and $XRP. This recognition initiates a public comment period, after which the SEC will decide on approval. Approval could legitimize these cryptocurrencies in https://t.co/vJ8rfc8TWJ
